description: Start or finish one work order operation, as the work-order screen's start and finish buttons do. Find operations and the moves each allows with get_work_order. start: a pending operation; on the standard screen it goes into preparation worked by assignedUserId (in-app, the confirming user by default) and the work order must be started; on an account with parallel operation execution it goes straight into progress, optionally on machineId (refused while that machine runs another operation). finish: an operation in preparation or progress (parallel: in progress); the next operation becomes pending, and finishing the last one leaves the work order waiting for completion. Completing the work order itself, which consumes materials and receives the output, stays a separate step. Preview first. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

assignedUserId.description: start only: the member (user id GUID) who works the operation. Required for connector credentials on the standard screen; defaults to the current assignee.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

machineId.description: start only, parallel operation execution only: the machine (GUID, from list_machines) to run it on; defaults to the operation's machine.

operationId.description: Work order operation id (GUID), from get_work_order's operations.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: transition_work_order_operation
title: Start or Finish Operation
